attributes.title: 2027 HPNA Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The 2027 HPNA Annual Conference takes place September 22 to 24, 2027, at the Renaissance Orlando at SeaWorld in Florida. It offers two days of education on clinical and emotional aspects of hospice and palliative nursing.

Registration opens in September, and attendees of the 2025 or 2026 conference receive an automatic loyalty discount. HPNA, an ANCC-accredited provider, will offer NCPD contact hours including pharmacotherapeutic hours; the totals and the fee amounts have not been published yet. Discounted rates run through July 15, 2027, and the conference hotel rate of $194 per night (plus tax and a $15 resort fee) is available until September 1, 2027.
